findings.text: File references move among FILE_REF_NOREF with live counts plus FILE_REF_SATURATED with FILE_REF_MAXREF plus FILE_REF_RELEASED with FILE_REF_DEAD. Dropping the final live marker attempts an exclusive move toward dead and on success authorizes deconstruction with acquire ordering, while other counts use a slow path that never authorizes teardown. Raw reads of refcnt expose the current marker.

A release observed while already inside the released or dead zone signals imbalance. The slow path emits a one time warning, restores FILE_REF_DEAD, and withholds deconstruction authority, treating the surplus release as harmless for teardown.

A release observed above FILE_REF_MAXREF is treated as saturated rather than empty. The implementation restores FILE_REF_SATURATED and withholds deconstruction, preserving the pinned high marker across further releases.

The limit sysctl_nr_open defaults to 1024 multiplied by 1024 while sysctl_nr_open_min equals BITS_PER_LONG. The ceiling sysctl_nr_open_max derives from INT_MAX bounded by pointer capacity then masked to word granularity. The fragments show default plus floor plus ceiling derivation without any runtime update path.

The carrier fdtable bundles fd with close_on_exec plus open_fds plus full_fds_bits plus max_fds plus rcu. Release frees the pointer array with open bitmap through one allocator while the header uses another, and RCU expiry reaches the same release through container linkage.

The live size estimate derives from the highest set open bit, aligned up to word size, falling back to NR_OPEN_DEFAULT when empty. When a hole range covers the tail, the estimate rescans only below the hole start and again defaults when that prefix is empty.

Duplication yields a fresh owner with singular count plus clean lock plus wait state plus cursor at start plus embedded storage initially, expanded as needed to cover the source live prefix. New bitmaps mirror the source live range, visible files gain a reference while missing slots become unused, trailing capacity stays cleared, and the table is published through RCU assignment.

Sampling of the source table with copying of entries occurs under the source owner lock. When the live prefix exceeds current capacity, the lock is released for table allocation then reacquired to resample, since the source may have grown concurrently.

Concurrent allocation may claim a slot whose file pointer is not yet published through lockless publication. The duplicate pass tolerates this by referencing only visible files and marking invisible slots unused, relying on the rule that disappearances require the lock.

Teardown walks set open bits and closes each present file with scheduling allowance, requiring sole ownership so neither RCU nor lock is needed for table access. The owner is freed only when its count reaches zero, freeing only non embedded tables, while task exit detaches the pointer under task lock before dropping a reference.

The owner carries embedded bitmap storage with embedded table plus array plus current table pointer plus next cursor plus wait queue with resize flag plus file_lock with count. The primordial init_files wires its pointer to its embedded table and starts with count one.

Unused descriptor acquisition starts scanning at zero under a caller supplied ceiling, with a convenience form using the process file number limit. Release of a claimed but unpublished slot requires the current owner lock.
Single descriptor close with unused slot release both serialize bitmap plus pointer mutation under the owner file lock, returning the prior file for unlocked teardown by the caller where applicable.

Range cloexec sets the close on exec interval while range close clears and closes each set descriptor in the interval. Both clamp the caller maximum to the live last index and idle when start exceeds the clamped maximum. The close walk drops the lock around each close plus on scheduling need, resampling the table after each drop.

The close range entry validates flag combination with ordering, optionally privatizes a shared table, then applies cloexec marking or closing over the interval and installs any privatized table before reporting success. Invalid flags with reversed range yield EINVAL while duplication failure propagates its error.

When unshare is requested on a shared owner, a private duplicate is built with the target interval omitted unless cloexec only mode preserves all entries for continued use. Work proceeds against the private copy and finally swaps it into the task while dropping the shared reference.

Lockless file acquisition elevates a reference then revalidates that the slot still holds the same pointer, using barrier pairing between reference acquisition with pointer publication. Mismatches with failed grabs report EAGAIN. One helper retries indefinitely while another maps any failure to null under an RCU read section.

Because file objects may be recycled in place under type safe RCU, a pointer match after reference acquisition is required to prove the reference belongs to the current occupant. The reloaded pointer is hidden from optimization to preserve dependency ordering before comparison.

Task scoped lookup operates under task lock to stabilize the owner pointer, with single descriptor plus forward scanning forms. The scanning form iterates from a caller cursor to capacity under RCU, updating the cursor to the match or to the end when none matches.

Light lookup borrows the raw pointer without elevation when the owner is exclusive, checked with acquire ordering against teardown, otherwise it clones with an elevated reference. A caller mode mask vetoes matches, with FMODE_PATH aware plus raw forms differing only in that mask, and failures yield EMPTY_FD while success yields BORROWED_FD or CLONED_FD.

The lightweight handle packs a file pointer with flag bits distinguishing borrowed handles needing no release plus cloned handles needing reference drop plus position locked handles needing mutex release. The borrowed with cloned constructors differ only in FDPUT_FPUT while position handling adds FDPUT_POS_UNLOCK.

Position mutex is required only for FMODE_ATOMIC_POS or shared iteration files when sharing is possible, judged by live reference multiplicity against FILE_REF_ONEREF with iteration capability. The position aware getter conditionally locks and marks the handle with a dedicated unlock helper, while a separate predicate conservatively demands locking for seek handling on such files.

Reception of an externally created file passes a security gate, reserves a descriptor honoring caller open flags, elevates the file, optionally reports the number to user memory, and notifies the socket layer before publishing. User memory failure aborts before publication.

Replacement into a chosen number passes security before installing, while duplication checks flag subset with aliasing plus process limit plus capacity expansion plus source existence under lock before delegating to a shared installer. O_CLOEXEC is the sole accepted flag, alias with over limit plus missing source yield EBADF, bad flags yield EINVAL, and expansion exhaustion via EMFILE maps to EBADF.

The three duplicate entries expose old to new copying with optional cloexec plus same number identity plus fresh number allocation. Self duplication only checks existence through RCU, while simple duplication grabs the source then allocates and installs, dropping the grab on allocation failure.

Iteration invokes a caller callback for each present file from a start index until the callback requests stop or capacity ends, holding no reference beyond the lock. A null owner yields immediate success without invocation.
The iteration walk holds the owner file lock throughout and dereferences each slot with a lock checked accessor tied to that held lock, keeping the table stable without RCU read sections.

Extended with legacy flags stay dual consistent for FS_XFLAG_CASEFOLD with FS_CASEFOLD_FL plus FS_XFLAG_VERITY with FS_VERITY_FL plus FS_XFLAG_PROJINHERIT with FS_PROJINHERIT_FL plus FS_XFLAG_DAX with FS_DAX_FL plus FS_XFLAG_NOATIME with FS_NOATIME_FL plus FS_XFLAG_NODUMP with FS_NODUMP_FL plus FS_XFLAG_APPEND with FS_APPEND_FL plus FS_XFLAG_IMMUTABLE with FS_IMMUTABLE_FL plus FS_XFLAG_SYNC with FS_SYNC_FL, each direction setting the counterpart and marking its own validity.
Kernel attribute retrieval requires filesystem support, failing with ENOIOCTLCMD when absent, then enforces security policy before delegating to the filesystem hook.

Conversion to user visible carriers zeroes the destination, masks extended flags, and copies extent size plus nextents plus project plus copy extent size. Kernel internal conversion rejects out of mask bits with EINVAL while user extended copy rejects them with EOPNOTSUPP, and user memory faults map to EFAULT.

The global FS_XFLAGS_MASK bounds visible with acceptable bits, while FS_XFLAG_RDONLY_MASK is always stripped from user supplied input before filling kernel state. The compact carrier omits nextents on input whereas the extended user carrier preserves it.

The kernel carrier holds dual validity markers with dual flag words plus extent size plus nextents plus project plus copy extent size. User carriers expose only the extended flag word with the same size with identity fields, without validity markers.

Observed descriptor control vocabulary includes CLOSE_RANGE_UNSHARE with CLOSE_RANGE_CLOEXEC plus O_CLOEXEC plus FMODE_PATH with FMODE_ATOMIC_POS plus FDPUT_FPUT with FDPUT_POS_UNLOCK plus RLIMIT_NOFILE, with failures via EINVAL plus EBADF plus EFAULT plus EOPNOTSUPP plus ENOIOCTLCMD, and numeric values shown only for sysctl bounds.
The helper BITBIT_NR computes the word count for a two level full hint bitmap by nesting the bits to longs conversion. The fragments show only its definition without any use site.
